definitions.vessel_associated_disturbance: Physical disturbance correlated in time and space with an AIS vessel track (anchor drag, trawl contact).
definitions.environmental_disturbance: Natural ambient or hydrodynamic event (ocean surface waves, seafloor turbulence, seismic tremors).
definitions.non_vessel_mechanical_disturbance: Mechanical impact or dropped object lacking vessel spatial-temporal corroboration.
definitions.sensor_system_fault: Sensor hardware malfunction, optical transmission link dropout, or packet degradation.
